title: I added loads more obstacles to my marble racing game! (Fable 5.2)
author: liltbrockie
selftext:
Marble Descent is a free marble racing game you play in your browser: no download, on your phone or computer.

Nine brand new obstacles this week, all on one long, steep course built in the game's Course builder:

\- Loop the loop: too slow and you drop off

\- Nissen Bend: up the wall, over the divider, down the other side

\- Extreme funnel: a slot barely wider than a marble, one at a time

\- Ski jump: big air, and a dive lands you faster

\- Slingshot bend: ride the rubber wall to be flung out faster

\- Corkscrew: a full barrel roll

\- Drop shaft: straight down, and a dive brings you out faster

\- Wave floor: the floor rolls under you

\- Bullseye: land on the green for a huge speed boost

Race this exact course yourself: [https://marbledescent.co.uk/?build=&bends=52727&features=rocket,funnel,uturn,spinner,bridge,bullseye,xfunnel,boost,waves,loop,banked,skijump,sling,flippers,shaft,drum,screw&kind=2,2&shape=1,1,1,1&v=22](https://marbledescent.co.uk/?build=&bends=52727&features=rocket,funnel,uturn,spinner,bridge,bullseye,xfunnel,boost,waves,loop,banked,skijump,sling,flippers,shaft,drum,screw&kind=2,2&shape=1,1,1,1&v=22)

48 obstacles in all and 4.3 billion possible courses, or build your own. Race solo against five bots, or online with your friends in a private room, or anyone in a quick race.

The weekly championship is where it gets serious: ten new courses every week, a leaderboard on every round, pace medals, an overall table, and a winner crowned every week. Watch the top runs, or race against them.

Chat about the game, share your times and suggest new obstacles on our Discord: [https://discord.gg/jQATpbeEx8](https://discord.gg/jQATpbeEx8)

Play free: [https://marbledescent.co.uk](https://marbledescent.co.uk)
